# `scope_set_connection_para`

<!-- Generated by tools/gen_cards.py from catalog/. Do not edit by hand. -->

Change the mount connection settings (index or baud rate, address and port).

## Summary

| Item | Value |
|---|---|
| Kind | method (client sends) |
| Grade | MUTATOR / established (64-bit build; 32-bit build matches (READ)) |
| Side-effect tier | C |
| Confidence | READ |
| Basis | static analysis of firmware 9.31, handler @0x71700 (64-bit build) |

Parses the optional members index, baud_rate, address and port and, when at least one yielded a value, calls the mount connection-parameter setter, which changes the operational device connection settings and the serial/network chooser. Success returns integer 0. Persistence, reconnect effects and subtype-specific meanings are unresolved. Served by the guider process (TCP 4400); a client on the main command port reaches it through the imager unknown-method relay, which is unavailable to guest-table clients. The native-handler grade below does not describe the relay.

Side effects: Changes operational mount connection settings (serial or network selection, address, port).

| `params` | any | no | - | Connection parameters. [READ] |

## Example

Request, network:

```json
{"id":41,"method":"scope_set_connection_para","params":{"address":"mount.example","port":"4030"}}
```

Reply, ok:

```json
{"jsonrpc":"2.0","Timestamp":"1234.123456789","method":"scope_set_connection_para","result":0,"code":0,"id":41}
```

Reply, err-209:

```json
{"jsonrpc":"2.0","Timestamp":"1234.123456789","method":"scope_set_connection_para","error":"invalid value","code":209,"id":42}
```
